imgDesc.text:
A mini Kresnik's Torch that can provide warmth for a small area for a short time. Using it will also generate Kresnik Energy orbs.
When it runs low on fuel, its effective range will significantly shrink, and it will no longer produce Kresnik Energy orbs. At this time, an energy injection from the Eye of Graeae can restore it to its normal state.
A mini Kresnik's Torch that has completely stopped working cannot be reactivated or restarted.
